  Scenario: AC6 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the harness delivers the same consumed event for "RW-2026-000501" a second time
    When the second delivery is consumed
    Then the case, its timers and its deviations are the same as after the first delivery
    And the event is not applied twice

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    When the harness requests a status change for "RW-2026-000501" from "IN_PROGRESS" that the model does not allow
    Then the change is refused
    And the case status stays "IN_PROGRESS"
    And no timer or deviation changes
